cells.value:
This template is used to record and report work performed for customer systems, including installation, replacement, modification, inspection, support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution activities.
It is designed to cover both hardware work and software/configuration work in one standard form.

The main objectives of this template are:
To record what work was actually performed on-site or remotely
To communicate the service result clearly to the customer
To provide traceable evidence for installation, correction, and support activities
To support follow-up actions, open items, and future troubleshooting
To prepare document control structure for ISO or quality system use in the future

This document should be used whenever the team performs any activity that changes, checks, restores, updates, or validates the customer’s system.
Report No., Report Date, Customer, Project/Site, Contact Person, Visit Type, Work Mode, Work Summary, Start/End DateTime, Service Team, Test Result, Customer Acceptance.
Record hardware work on the left half and software/configuration work on the right half. Leave unused rows blank.
Describe issue/symptom, impact, root cause, action taken, downtime, backup check, and rollback need.

Maintain template revision in Doc_Control sheet. When structure changes, update revision history with date, owner, and summary of change.
Rev.00 = Initial release
Rev.01 = Added software/configuration section
Rev.02 = Added customer acknowledgement and pending item fields
Store reports by Year > Customer > Project > Service Report, and keep signed PDF copy if customer signs by hand.
Use Example_Filled_ISO as a reference when training service engineers.
